study.question: Can preventing the new temporal-content summary from directly updating shared category/brand embeddings rescue its failed integration with compact count/freshness and match-group evidence, beyond the same routing change applied to a marginal-product control?
study.hypothesis: Observed: all four round-13 content variants underperform the scalar second-moment incumbent. Covariance has lower AUC than incumbent by 0.0005848813799509 despite a nonzero supplied diagnostic head effect (0.0846195 RMS) and responds to within-cell age swaps (0.0933012 logit RMS). Source inspection shows a new gradient route from the content projection into shared embeddings. Provisional explanation: that additional route may distort shared content representations; detaching only the selected content summary may recover useful association evidence while preserving ordinary backbone/gate training. No adverse gradient conflict has been measured; generic regularization, feature scale, overfitting, bottleneck interference and seed variation are live alternatives.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit entire covariance model, all numeric forward values and module initialization. New local intervention adds Tensor.detach only between selected temporal-content features and their inherited content_projection; no new inference information or parameters.
Use the exact marginal-product representation as the matched other factor, with the same attachment intervention and full standalone code.

nearest_work.difference: DIN uses learned target-dependent weighted sums and explicitly relaxes weight normalization to retain intensity. Here grouping and one-day decay are fixed and inherited; the new factor changes gradient routing only. The local DIN reference uses normalized softmax and is an adaptation, not a faithful full-paper reproduction. No general novelty claim for pooling, moments, covariance, residuals or stop-gradient.
Author README confirms available category/brand/behavior fields and lack of item identity. No item reconstruction, auxiliary labels, or DMR reproduction; publisher mechanism unavailable.

inherited_components: All four round-13 content summaries E[d*x], E[d]*E[x], Cov(d,x), E[x] and the fixed decay d=exp(-age/86400). x is category+brand embeddings only; no action or learned recency embeddings in x.
Exclusive target-match/action cell definitions, static embeddings, pooled context, count and first/second decay moments, correction MLP, RMS context gate and base classifier.
Zero-initialized 256-to-32 content_projection after all incumbent modules, retaining source initialization order and 8192 extra parameters relative to incumbent.
Host labels, causal features, split, scorer, checkpoints, scratch initialization, loss, optimizer, training passes and seed policy.
study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 content-statistic (covariance versus product-of-marginals) by gradient-route (attached versus detached) factorial. In the detached cells the selected content feature is replaced by its value-preserving Tensor.detach before the same projection. Other backbone/context paths remain differentiable. Attached arms are same-seed implementation replays of round-13 sources, not independent mechanism replications. This is a locally new optimization intervention, not a claimed new general method; registry gradient search returned no nearest-paper hits and novelty remains unverified.
predictions: At identical tensors and batch, attached and detached versions have equal logits; only backward paths differ. All four variants allocate 17,148,867 parameters. The new switches consume no random draws.

Gradient-path prediction by source semantics: the selected feature supplies no derivative into category/brand embeddings in detached mode; attached mode retains the original derivative. Embeddings still receive base and context gradients. No runtime gradient measurement is claimed from no_grad diagnostics.

If covariance-specific embedding feedback is consequential, DC improves over AC and more than DF improves over AF; DC should also beat DF and the 0.6203426149570374 incumbent to demonstrate useful recovery.

Covariance remains zero in singleton/constant-content/constant-age cells and empty histories; marginal-product replacement is invariant to within-cell age-content reassignment, covariance generally is not.
Training cost may decrease when a backward route is removed; report actual host wall/GPU time, examples processed, memory and latency rather than asserting equal compute or efficiency from source.
falsifiers: If attached replay deviates materially from its original source with identical seed/recipe, halt interpretation of the interaction and diagnose provenance/numerical execution first; do not hide the failed cost.
If DC<=AC, blocking this path has not rescued the failed covariance implementation in this execution. If DC<=DF or DC<=incumbent, useful new association evidence remains unsupported even if DC>AC.
If DF and DC improve equally and interaction is nonpositive, results support at most generic routing/regularization, not an association-specific repair.
Any invalid mask/empty/padding identity, nonfinite prediction, protocol mismatch or unavailable input invalidates predictive interpretation.
A positive seed-42 contrast that reverses across paired seeds leaves repeatable utility unsupported; no significance claims from one seed or diagnostic subset.
alternative_explanations: Generic regularization of shared embedding updates rather than harmful association gradients.
The 8192-parameter branch or injection into the 32-dimensional correction preactivation overfits or interferes with the scalar readout; stopping only content derivatives may not repair that.
Covariance is much smaller in RMS (0.0453) than marginal-product (0.2742); scale-dependent optimization can mimic a routing interaction.
Within-cell content-age association may lack useful residual information at the truncated category/brand resolution.
Sparse cell support, limited training passes, checkpoint/seed noise and adaptive validation selection; source snapshot as-of uncertainty remains.
